function: Provide the satellite's energy
prevention: Use cells qualified for space, radiation shielding
detection_controls: Real-time telemetry (low cell voltage, battery temperature)

function: Charge the battery
prevention: Simple mechanisms (passive deployment), resistant materials, lubrication
detection_controls: Deployment sensors, decrease in energy production

function: Perform all the calculations
prevention: Radiation shield, recovery mechanisms (fault-tolerant)
detection_controls: Repeated restarts, memory errors, corrupted data

function: Give orders to the satellite elements and allow the mission
causes: Faulty update / watchdog, Inexperienced software teams
prevention: Rigorous validation of updates, rollback mechanism (returning to the previous version)
detection_controls: Repeated restarts

function: Critical for imaging
prevention: Thermal coatings, sensor suitable for high thermal ranges
detection_controls: Differences between the measurements and those of other sensors

function: Stability of the satellite
prevention: Limit the rotation speed, non-rough gear shifting
detection_controls: Maximum speed reached, loss of attitude control, loss of attitude control

function: Transmit the information between the satellite and the ground
prevention: Thermal management: active (fan), passive (fin), limit power according to temperature
detection_controls: Abnormally high current, intermittent transmissions, temperature sensor

function: Deploy the elements that need to be deployed to function
prevention: Passive mechanisms (springs, hinges, ...), resistant materials
detection_controls: No deployment confirmation, abnormal electrical power, transmission problems

function: Allows management of the satellite's temperature
prevention: Thermal management: active (fan), passive (fin), limit power according to temperature
detection_controls: Temperature detected by the sensors, performance drop

function: Test what the satellite can withstand
prevention: Structured test plans, phased integration milestones, peer review of test procedures
detection_controls: Test anomaly logs, functional verification failures, subsystem performance deltas

function: Maintain operational continuity across team transitions
prevention: Documented procedures, handover protocols, operations manuals
detection_controls: Repetitive errors, delays in operations

function: Secure adequate funding for all mission phases
effects: Reduced testing, cheaper components, higher failure rate
causes: Poor budget planning, underestimated costs, loss of sponsor
prevention: Early budget planning, contingency reserves, multiple funding sources
detection_controls: Budget shortfall reports, procurement delays

function: Ensure timely availability of funds
causes: Institutional approval delays, sponsor payment schedules
prevention: Early funding requests, phased budget release agreements
detection_controls: Missed procurement milestones, schedule slippage

function: Maintain expenditure within approved budget
effects: Cuts to other subsystems (thermal, ADCS, testing)
causes: Inaccurate estimates, scope creep, supplier price changes
prevention: Regular budget reviews, contingency allocation, scope control
detection_controls: Budget tracking reports, variance against planned spend

function: Produce accurate cost estimates for mission planning
causes: Inexperience, optimism bias, insufficient market research
prevention: Use of established cost models (SSCM), analogous estimation, expert review
detection_controls: Mid-project redesigns, procurement delays, budget variance

function: Procure components at budgeted cost
causes: Market fluctuations, currency changes, supply chain disruption
prevention: Early procurement, fixed-price agreements where possible
detection_controls: Supplier quotes exceeding budget, forced component substitution

function: Deliver components on time and within budget
prevention: Domestic sourcing where possible, early customs assessment
detection_controls: Delivery delays, invoices exceeding estimates

function: Secure affordable launch slot
causes: Rideshare market changes, launch provider policy changes
prevention: Early launch agreements, rideshare options (e.g. NASA ELaNa, ESA SSO)
detection_controls: Revised launch provider quotes, budget shortfall

function: Execute full verification and validation programme
prevention: Prioritise critical tests, seek shared facility access, university lab partnerships
detection_controls: Test programmer gaps, skipped verification steps

function: Procure components meeting minimum reliability requirements
prevention: Define minimum reliability specifications, seek supplier donations
detection_controls: Higher than expected failure rates during testing

function: Maintain mission continuity through redundant systems
prevention: Design for graceful degradation, prioritise redundancy in safety-critical subsystems
detection_controls: Single-point failure events, subsystem outages with no backup

function: Deliver technically sound design and integration
causes: Insufficient funding for experienced staff, student team composition
prevention: Mentorship programmes, peer review, structured training, documented procedures
detection_controls: Software bugs found during testing, wiring errors during integration

failure_mode: System/process remains incomplete and misses launch window
function: Deliver components on schedule for integration
description: System/process remains incomplete and misses launch window
causes: Late ordering, long supplier lead times, customs delays
prevention: Early procurement planning, buffer lead times, alternative suppliers identified
detection_controls: Missed integration milestones, incomplete subsystem assembly

function: To provide adequate thermal control hardware (radiators, insulation, coatings, heaters) that maintains components within safe operating temperatures.
causes: Insufficient funding forcing omission of active thermal hardware
prevention: Passive thermal solutions prioritised (coatings, MLI blankets, thermal straps)
detection_controls: Temperature exceedances during thermal vacuum testing

function: The signal between the ground and the satellite allows for monitoring and control
description: Electromagnetic interference, limited equipment, atmospheric conditions
causes: Environment and elements of the satellite
prevention: Durable cables, low-pass filters, good transmitters / receivers
detection_controls: Error detection codes, comparison of the received data with existing models

function: Detect all abnormal variations that could impact the satellite's behavior
description: Poor sensor calibration, bugs in processing algorithms
effects: Loss of control of the satellite's behavior
prevention: Preliminary vibration test, good calibration
detection_controls: Good sensors, good calibration

failure_mode: Misalignment between mission goals and available resources
item: Misalignment between mission goals and available resources
function: To ensure mission objectives, scope, and technical requirements match the available budget, schedule, and workforce capacity.
description: Lack of proper resource for a process can degrade performance of the subsystem
effects: Interdependence of subsystems can lead to more internal failures
causes: Overambitious objectives, insufficient resource assessment at planning stage
prevention: Early resource-constrained trade studies, iterative mission definition reviews
detection_controls: Schedule slippage, budget overruns, subsystem performance shortfalls

function: To accurately determine the satellite’s mass distribution and inertia so the ADCS can compute correct attitude control commands
description: Calculations not suited to real model
effects: Loss of control of the satellite's trajectory, drift
prevention: Data rechecking and reanalysis
detection_controls: Difference in result between the existing model and the input data

function: To design components that can be reliably fabricated, assembled, and tested without defects or performance degradation.
causes: Lack of expertise, production constraints, underestimated deadlines and costs
prevention: Simplify designs, durability tests
detection_controls: Visual and dimensional inspections, functional tests

failure_mode: Tumble rate too high for ADCS capture
item: Tumble rate too high for ADCS capture
function: To allow the ADCS to acquire, stabilize, and control the satellite’s attitude after deployment or disturbances.
description: Violent separation at launch, failure of a reaction wheel, poor controller settings, bugs in the algorithms
effects: Loss of control of the satellite's trajectory, drift, loss of communication
prevention: Balancing the center of gravity, pre-launch tests, stabilization software
detection_controls: Inability to follow the movement,loss of communication,decrease in energy supply to the battery

function: Initiate contact with the satellite and start the mission
description: Bad deployment of the antenna, problems of frequences, wrong direction of the antenna
effects: No control over the satellite and possibly no start of the mission
prevention: Pre-launch antenna deployment verification, frequency coordination (IARU), ground station pointing calibration
detection_controls: No contact with the satellite, difficulties in knowing the cause

function: Stability of the satellite
effects: Loss of directional accuracy, solar panels / poorly oriented antenna
causes: External environment and default of the satellite elements
prevention: Good gyroscope, good calibration and testing in conditions
detection_controls: Comparison of the behavior with the results of other sensors (Star tracker,...)

function: To provide accurate, reliable measurements for navigation, control, and system monitoring.
description: Damage caused by the problems encountered, aging of the sensors
effects: Decrease in the accuracy of the records
causes: Sensors not suited to the stresses endured or undersized
prevention: Sensors adapted to the stresses endured
detection_controls: Aberrant values, difficulties in returning data

function: To manage, store, and process onboard data without exceeding memory or processing limits.
effects: OBC crash: Memory saturation or blockage, performance degradation, data loss
causes: Limited resources, programming errors, unexpected data flow
prevention: Robust memory management ("data throttling" mechanisms, ...), computer restart
detection_controls: Slowing of responses, unexplained restarts, error messages in the logs

function: To determine the satellite’s orientation using sensors (gyros, magnetometers, star trackers).
description: Gyroscope problem, disturbed magnetometers, poor calibration
effects: Loss of precise pointing (for the antenna and solar panels)
causes: Gyroscope problem, disturbed magnetometers, poor calibration
prevention: Regular calibration, pre-launch vibration tests
detection_controls: Inconsistencies between sensors (gyroscopes / magnetometers), difference with good results (for the antenna and the energy from the solar panels)

function: To execute onboard software reliably, maintain control loops, and manage subsystem operations.
description: Software bugs, software corruption, configuration problem
effects: Loss of control of the satellite, loss of energy, halt of certain operations
prevention: Software stress tests, protected memory
detection_controls: If the OBC records logs in a memory, some repetitive signals

function: To detect, isolate, and respond to anomalies to protect the spacecraft and maintain operations.
description: Undersizing of the satellite's components, and backup program steps
causes: Undersizing of components, incomplete backup procedure definition, insufficient FDIR testing
prevention: FDIR validation against failure scenarios, end-to-end testing of recovery procedures, independent review
detection_controls: Persistent problem or continuously worsening

failure_mode: Failure to execute deorbit / disposal plan
item: Failure to execute deorbit / disposal plan
function: To safely perform end-of-life maneuvers ensuring compliance with space-debris mitigation rules.
effects: Space debris, non-compliance with space rules
prevention: Passive mechanisms (automatic deorbiting system), preliminary test (Simulate failures)
detection_controls: Ground-based surveillance, radar or optical

function: To collect, store, and transmit scientific or mission-critical payload data accurately.
description: Radiation, electromagnetic interference, software error, storage problems
effects: Unusable scientific data, loss of the mission's purpose
prevention: Radiation protection, stable power supply, data integrity
detection_controls: Outlier values, data problems, reading errors

function: To maintain correct digital logic states in processors, FPGAs, and control electronics.
description: Each subsystem depends on proper functioning of previous subsystem process
effects: Interdependence of subsystems can lead to more internal failures
causes: High-energy particle radiation in LEO environment
prevention: Radiation-hardened or radiation-tolerant components, error-correcting code (ECC) memory, watchdog timers
detection_controls: Unexpected resets, corrupted telemetry, anomalous command execution

function: To regulate and distribute stable electrical power to all subsystems.
description: Wiring defects, damaged battery, failure of regulators
effects: Damage to components, power outages, restarts
prevention: Voltage regulators and continuous monitoring
detection_controls: Electric voltage sensor

function: To transmit telemetry, payload data, and command responses from satellite to ground.
description: Orbital drift, increasing interference, space environment
effects: Loss of control of the satellite
prevention: Link margin analysis, frequency coordination, ground station diversity
detection_controls: Signal loss, transmission errors

function: To maintain safe, stable electrical grounding paths and prevent stray currents or EMI.
description: Corrosion of electrical systems, crack caused by shocks
effects: Damage to the components, unexpected restarts
prevention: Apply conductive coatings to prevent oxidation
detection_controls: Indirect signs: unexpected restarts,... . Difficult without a built-in ohmmeter

function: Accurately model and use the satellite’s mass distribution and inertia properties
description: Inaccurate readings of the satellite's center of gravity and mass
effects: Loss of control of the satellite's trajectory, drift
causes: Measurements on the satellite, faults, damage
prevention: Rigorous analysis of the mass of the satellite
detection_controls: Difference in result between the existing model and the input data

function: Clock: coordination of subsystems, orbit and attitude calculations, task planning
description: Inaccurate clocks, disturbance of the spatial environment
prevention: External synchronization, miniaturized atomic clocks
detection_controls: Comparison with external references

function: Each system/process requires optimal performance reports
description: Overestimations can lead to improper system performance review
effects: Interdependence of subsystems can lead to more internal failures
causes: Inexperience, pressure to meet requirements, lack of heritage data for COTS components
prevention: Conservative margin policies (per ECSS-E-ST-10-03), independent design reviews, use of historical CubeSat performance data
detection_controls: In-orbit performance below predicted levels, subsystem telemetry deviating from model

failure_mode: Latch-up in power or logic devices
item: Latch-up in power or logic devices
function: Current system function according to code
description: Through proper identification and regular monitoring
effects: Could lead to failure of other systems/items/processes
prevention: Regular monitoring and code maintenance
detection_controls: Regular monitoring and code maintenance. Trend logging and monitoring

function: Prompt identification of current state function
description: Lack of knowledge/documentation can lead to late problem solving
effects: Can lead to more loss of other systems due to lack of understanding
prevention: Proper documentation that follows an order and according to standards
detection_controls: Organised system set in place that are followed
